From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Subject: Executive recap: Redwood discussion — procurement & risk (Quantix Systems)

Hi Lisa / Tom -

Thanks again for the time today. Quick executive-level recap from our discovery so we have alignment on business outcomes, risks, and the procurement path. I captured the action items at the end. Please flag any corrections.

What we heard (pain / drivers)
- Current internal search/chat pipelines are causing high latency for agent workflows (avg 2.5s per call at peak), driving poor user engagement and revenue leakage on support automation.
- Cost predictability is a blocker for expanding to 3rd-party integrations. Quarterly spend variability has been 40%+.
- Data isolation and auditability are requirements for productizing in regulated verticals (PCI / SOC considerations).

Goals & business outcomes
- Reduce inference latency to <= 1.2s p95 for customer-facing agents.
- Cap monthly inference spend growth to <15% QoQ during pilot.
- Enable an auditable private deployment option for PII-sensitive flows within H2 scope.

Key risks we discussed
- Procurement timeline: need PO/SOW signed before the end of Q2 to hit roadmap commitments.
- Security review: SOC2 evidence and a short architectural review are required for Prod rollouts.
- Exec sponsorship: need a clear sponsor to fast-track legal and procurement.

Procurement path (recommended)
1) Pilot: 3-month proof-of-concept (dedicated capacity slice) - technical success criteria: latency & throughput metrics + 1 integration.
2) Legal: Redwood provides standard terms + SOC2 policy package; Quantix legal to provide any redlines.
3) Procurement: PO or 1-year reserved capacity upon pilot success.

Proposed next steps
- Redwood: share Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a draft SOW + pricing for the 3-month pilot (attached).
- Quantix: confirm exec sponsor, procurement contact, and initial PO timeline.
- Schedule an architecture session with Quantix infra and our security lead next week.

Attachments included: Quantix_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx, Redwood_SLA_and_Pricing.pdf

Action items (for clarity)
- Lisa: confirm exec sponsor and procurement contact (due EOD Thu).
- Tom: confirm timeline goals for product roadmap (flexible slot next week).
- Sean / Marissa: send MAP + draft SOW and coordinate architecture session.

Thanks - looking forward to moving this forward.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0138
